system: Cooling (engine thermostat / water pump control, hybrid system coolant pump)

fault_codes.text_on_tool: Engine electronic water pump PWM control line short circuit to ground

symptoms: Both codes stored together in the PDC
After clearing, both codes return immediately at ignition ON
findings: Water pump checked with the scan tool Active Test: the pump responded
The scan tool marks both code definitions as generic, for reference only
diagnosis: The two codes name the engine thermostat circuit and the engine water pump PWM line, but wiring and the pump tested good. The fault cleared after replacing the coolant pump of the hybrid electric system. The engine (ICE) coolant pump was not replaced.
repair_steps: Replaced the coolant pump of the hybrid electric system
Cleared the codes and monitored the vehicle: no fault returned

parts_replaced.part: Coolant pump of the hybrid electric system (mechanic's wording: مضخة تبريد النظام الكهربائي الهجين)
